subject: Request: One-off commercial flexibility for Medivance — VP/CFO signoff needed
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Medivance — ask for one-off flexibility / VP signoff

Team — quick summary and ask. Medivance asked for a final commercial concession to close a $2.1M ARR commitment that converts a 6‑month pilot into a 12‑month committed capacity deal. Key asks: 30% first‑year discount applied to hosted API list rates, a 12‑month onboarding credit of $75k, and a clause to allow limited burst capacity without per‑token overage for the first 90 days.

Why this matters: closing this would secure a significant reference account in the cardiology vertical and a co‑marketing commitment; they also bring three regional hospitals with clear future expansion signals. My read: deal economics are marginal but defensible if we tightly scope the burst and require commit levels.

What I need from you both: a VP/CFO level memo for signoff that documents precedent, net ARR impact (incl. credits), and suggested guardrails (true‑up cadence, termination carveouts). Attached: the latest mutual action plan and usage forecast.

Proposed quick guardrails (my draft):
- 30% off list on first 12 months only, revert to standard rates after term.
- $75k onboarding credit drawn down against the first three invoices.
- Burst allowance: up to 2x committed RPS for 90 days; any sustained >2x will trigger auto‑throttle and negotiated overage.
- Monthly usage reporting and quarterly business review; optional holdback clause tied to onboarding milestones.

If you agree, I can circulate a short memo to Marissa + CFO thread and request formal signoff. This is time sensitive — Aaron says they need final terms by Friday 09/04 to align board procurement.

Thanks,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-03T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Medivance — ask for one-off flexibility / VP signoff

Naomi — thanks for the concise summary. I ran a quick impact calc: with the 30% concession and the $75k credit, TCV for year one drops ~28% vs list, but NPV over 3 years remains positive given expected multi‑year expansion signals. Important caveats: we should require an annual minimum commit clause (systematic true‑up) to protect against usage skew.

I recommend we:
1) Frame the concession as a limited, one‑time onboarding package (explicitly non‑precedential).
2) Add a clause that the discount only applies if Medivance signs the 12‑month addendum and provides a letter of intent for the hospitals within 30 days.
3) Tie the onboarding credit to deliverables (SLA baseline delivery and POC completion).

I can draft the VP/CFO memo this afternoon and include precedent examples. If Markus agrees on the finance guardrails we can send to Medivance tomorrow.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP, Commercial Strategy | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-03T13:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Medivance — ask for one-off flexibility / VP signoff

Agree with Marissa. A couple of tactical suggestions to tighten margins while keeping the commercial closeable:
- Convert the 30% to a stepped discount: 30% for months 1–3, 20% for months 4–6, then 10% for months 7–12 — keeps headline low while protecting revenue later.
- Replace unrestricted burst allowance with a transient credit bucket: allow up to 10M tokens from a shared surge pool; any consumption beyond that billed at 50% of list rate.
- Add an early expansion incentive: if their three hospitals convert within 9 months, apply a one‑time account credit (not cash) equal to 25% of onboarding credit toward professional services.

I can model this quickly if you want numbers for the memo.

— Karthik
Senior Director, Sales Operations
From: Aaron Lee <aaron.lee@medivance.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-04T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Medivance — ask for one-off flexibility / VP signoff

Naomi — appreciate the transparency and the draft guardrails. Procurement is on a tight cadence; our CFO team needs a short approval note from Redwood that lists the final commercial concessions and the exact billing mechanics for the onboarding credit and burst treatment. Can you please confirm by EOD Thursday 09/04 so we can finalize with our board?

If it helps, we can accept a stepped discount approach — but need certainty on how the onboarding credit is applied on invoices and evidence that burst allowance has a hard cap.

Thanks,
Aaron
Aaron Lee
Head of Cloud Platforms, Medivance
aaron.lee@medivance.com
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-04T16:08:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Medivance — request for final signoff (draft memo attached)

Marissa / Markus / Karthik — I attached a short memo for VP/CFO signoff that consolidates the stepped discount + surge pool approach Karthik suggested and the milestone‑tied onboarding credit. Highlights in the memo:
- Stepped discount schedule (30% / 20% / 10%) for months 1/4/7 respectively; discount expires after 12 months.
- Onboarding credit: $75k applied as invoice credits across first three invoices; any unused credit expires after 180 days.
- Surge pool: 10M token shared bucket; post‑bucket usage billed at 50% list; auto‑throttle at 2.5x committed baseline.
- Non‑precedent language and clause requiring LOI for hospital rollouts within 30 days.

If you approve I will send this to their CFO and request formal signoff. Please reply with a short OK or with edits. We need a yes/no by 18:00 PT to meet their board window.

Naomi

--- Forwarded message ---
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Medivance CFO <cfo@medivance.com>
Date: 2026-09-04T16:09:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood / Medivance — commercial summary (for CFO review)

Aaron / CFO team — attaching our final commercial summary for your review. High level: we are prepared to offer a stepped onboarding discount and a capped surge credit bucket in exchange for a signed 12‑month commitment and the hospital LOI. The attached memo lists exact billing mechanics and the proposed addendum language.

Regards,
Naomi
